structuredOutput.rationale: The candidate is a proposed custody contract for a bounded local implementation packet, not a code change. Bundle identity checks pass: empty diff, matching SHAs, and artifact hashes match the supplied content. The contract itself is internally consistent with the Midnight source extracts on persistentHash role gating, constructor disclose of derived keys, one-shot initialized, entry-balance unshieldedBalance semantics, receiveUnshielded not authenticating a payer, and rejection of ownPublicKey/witness authorization. Acceptance is limited to authorizing a later local packet that must still specify exact source, encodings, custody, financial comparisons, and controls. No transaction is authorized by this artifact. No material defect is present in the proposal text relative to the cited Compact/stdlib/tutorial extracts. Compact proof-enabled public tests, Preview inclusion, and actual transaction IDs remain out of scope as the contract itself states.
